page.overview:
Who is Jun Kazama?

Missing (Jin believes she was killed by Ogre) (TK3-TK7)Unknown, possibly alive

Jun was a wildlife surveillance officer of the conservation group WWWC. She used Kazama Style Traditional Martial Arts, a martial art that has been handed down the Kazama family for generations.

Jun grew up surrounded by nature on the island of Yakushima, where she was taught the ways of the Kazama-style martial arts and developed strong psychic abilities. Other people grew afraid of her due to her unusual abilities, and she spent many years isolated and alone. She only felt able to be herself around animals due to their purity of heart and freedom from negative thoughts. Eventually, she felt suffocated on the island and moved to Tokyo to study at university. City life distanced her from her spirituality - until, one night, she had a dream of her father bidding her farewell. She subsequently learned that her father had passed away. This event stirred something in her, and she began to remember the animals she had been close to in Yakushima. She decided to become a wildlife surveillance officer for the WWWC, an animal conservation group.

It was during her time in Tokyo, while working for WWWC, that she heard of a man named Kazuya Mishima, who was involved in the smuggling of endangered animals. Jun entered the King of Iron Fist Tournament 2, hoping to arrest Kazuya there; however, she immediately sensed a mysterious power surrounding him. She came to see him as a kindred spirit, someone who had been misunderstood as a result of his powers and forced to endure a life of loneliness as a result. She believed that she was one of the only people in the world who would be able to empathize with him and save him from his solitude. She approached Kazuya without fear and the two of them grew very close. Jun became pregnant with Kazuya's child. Eventually, however, Kazuya confronted his father, who defeated him in battle and subsequently disposed of his son's body in an active volcano.
